metrics.method: Counted over the full 52-message history (45 non-service messages, 2026-06-22 to 2026-09-05). Client messages total 7; 'questions' counts explicit asks (PayPal rail, IG targeting report, payment extension). 'Unanswered over 24h' = the PayPal question (never answered) and the 2026-07-22 IG targeting report (~30h to a one-line reply). max_team_silence_days measures client-facing ALTR messages: the largest in-relationship gap was 10 days (2026-07-01 to 2026-07-11); the final gap runs from 2026-08-26 to the present with no client-facing message ever again (30 days to her internal removal on 2026-09-05). Promises = explicit forward commitments by ALTR.

what_client_wanted: Her main Instagram protected from targeting and restrictions - the only thing she ever raised unprompted: 'My Cheymai_ account is being targeted now' (2026-07-22).

A payment rail and timing that matched her OnlyFans payout cycle: 'Do you guys have PayPal' (2026-07-13) and 'Can you give me 4 more days please I'm just waiting for money to turn over from OF' (2026-08-11).
Invoices somewhere she would actually see them - she told us plainly she had missed one: 'Oh I didn't even see this was for 2nd of August! I'm so sorry' (2026-08-11).

The IG promo/posting programme to actually restart after the phone-farm migration, with a date - after 'we will have plenty of updates starting next week' (Derrek, 2026-08-01) the Promo topic carried zero messages for her remaining 41 days.
what_worked: Same-day payment acknowledgement built trust cheaply: 'Recieved!' (Stephski, 2026-07-13) and 'thank you so much' (2026-07-23). She replied to every chase within minutes right up to her last message.
Granting her the payment extension without friction - 'Okay no problem' (Stephski, 2026-08-11) - produced the warmest message she ever sent: an unprompted apology for having missed the invoice.

Mayson's immediate account check when she reported IG targeting - 'Can you check your account status rq?' (2026-07-23) - got her to send a screenshot within a minute. Fast, specific asks always worked on this client.
top_fix: Give every account one named owner with a hard rule: if a client who has always replied goes 14 days silent, the owner makes off-thread contact (we had her phone number and gave her ours) instead of sending a fourth invoice chase - and no client may be removed from the tooling until that owner has sent a written termination notice and a final statement.
